event_name: Cornwell Quality Tools NHRA U.S. Nationals

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 67 degrees, relative humidity 78 percent, barometer 30.11 inches,
adjusted altitude 1,914 feet, track temperature 89 degrees.

Justin Ashley wins 76% of his Rd. 1 races when he has lane choice. The #9 TF qualifier is 6 - 4 in
Rd. 1 here in the last 10 years.

Ashley is 3 - 0 against Reed in prior events. 

A couple great lights, but Reed shook hard right at the hit and clicked it off.
Ashley is straight down the groove with his quickest pass of the weekend for the win.

Jasmine Salinas's 332.75 in qualifying is her fastest run ever at this event.  Tripp Tatum  is 9 - 11
in Rd. 1.

This is the first time Salinas and Tatum have faced each other in eliminations. 

Tatum with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest pass of
the weekend for the win.
Salinas overpowers the track around half tack and clicks it off.

Tony Stewart is 4 - 0 in Rd. 1 when qualified #2. The #15 TF qualifier has won twice in Rd. 1 in the
last 3 years here.

Zizzo is 1 - 0 against Stewart in prior events. 

Stewart with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes the quickest pas of
the event for the win.

Zizzo was straight down the groove with his quickest pass of the weekend in the losing effort.

Shawn Langdon's 404 round wins in TF are the 9th most in class history.  Clay Millican's 343 round
wins are 10th most in TF. The last time the #16 TF qualifier won a round here was 2017.

Langdon is 19 - 16 against Millican in prior events. 

Langdon with the starting line advantage and makes the quickest and fastest pass of the event for the
win.  Shawn Langdon's incremental times: 60ft-0.842 sec., 330ft-2.126, 660ft-2.995/294.18 mph. 
He will have lane choice over Ashley in the next round.

Millican is up in smoke right at the hit and clicked it off.

Doug Kalitta is 55 - 17 in Rd. 1 when qualified #3. The #14 TF qualifier has upset the #3 qualifier
in each of the last 2 years. 

Kalitta is 3 - 0 against Smith in prior events. 

Smith with the starting line advantage, but Kalitta was right there with and had the lead by the time
they go by the Christmas tree.  He runs the quickest and fastest pass of the event for the win.  He
will have lane choice over Tatum in the next round.

Billy Torrence has been in the top half of the field at 11 of his 14 races this year. Maddi Gordon
beat Torrence is Rd. 1 at Bristol.

Gordon is 1 - 0 against Torrence in prior events. 

Gordon with a great light and never trailed for the win.  She makes her quickest and fastest pass
this weekend for the win.

Torrence with a good clean pass in the losing effort.

Leah Pruett set Top Speed in Brainerd, just the 6th time in her career she has done that. Josh Hart
is 4 - 2 against Pruett in Rd. 1 races (0 - 1 this year).

Hart is 5 - 4 against Pruett in prior events. 

Hart with the starting line advantage, but is dropping cylinders early, but stays with it.

Pruett kept it hooked up an hitting on all eight for the win and her quickest and fastest pass.  She
will have lane choice over Gordon in the next round.

Ida Zetterstrom is #7 & the #7 TF qualifier has never won this race. The only other TF qualifier to
never win this race is #16.  Antron Brown is 14 - 8 in Rd. 1 when #10 (2 - 0 this year).

Zetterstrom is 2 - 1 against Brown in prior events. 

Brown with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He makes his quickest and
fastest pass of the weekend for the win.  He will give up lane choice to stewart in the next round.

Zetterstrom started to lose traction and drop cylinders before she clicked it off.
